name: BuildingConnected
purpose: Invitation and addendum channel for GCs who run their bid lists on BuildingConnected (e.g. SA Casey Construction). Addenda arrive here, not by direct email.

auth.notes: Autodesk Platform Services exposes a BuildingConnected API but it requires an Autodesk app + partner-level access. Not provisioned.

known_limits: Subject lines are truncated with an ellipsis ('Willow Run Park Renov...') - never key dedupe on subject alone.
Addendum notices look like new invitations to a keyword filter; they must merge into the existing project record.
Attachments are frequently referenced as 'uploaded' with no file attached - the plan must be pulled from the portal.
owner_action_required: Confirm whether the Autodesk/BuildingConnected account tier permits API access; if so this moves from email scraping to a real feed.
